Validations.Reason: The finalized chapter explicitly describes the group executing a new tactical maneuver to drain the accumulated Blight into the western drainage channels. It confirms Kaelen acted as a biological pump at the cost of his vitality (skin cracking, essence leaking) and that he collapsed into a protective sleep. The text states the barrier is stable but emptied, and the Blight is now moving west toward the forest, forcing the group to pursue it. This materially advances the conflict by resolving the immediate saturation threat while introducing the new mobile threat.

The chapter directly depicts Kaelen sustaining the active 'pull' until his body physically degrades (skin cracking, leaking essence) and he collapses into a magical sleep. The text confirms this state is a protective mechanism induced by the magic to prevent total consumption, answering the mystery of his limits (sustainable only briefly). This materially develops the thread by establishing the specific cost and duration of his role as a pump.

The chapter resolves the mystery of the barrier's capacity by explicitly stating Maren's realization that it functions as a finite reservoir ('cup') rather than an infinite sink. It confirms the seal can be manipulated to drain the Blight into the channels, changing the nature of the threat from static containment failure to a mobile pursuit. This materially advances the thread by refining the operational mechanics and shifting the strategic challenge.
